before: An abstract class cannot be instantiated directly. It can contain ordinary implemented methods alongside abstract methods that a concrete subclass must implement.
The inherited describe method calls $this->label(). On a Lesson object, that call reaches Lesson’s implementation. The shared class supplies the sentence shape, while the subclass supplies its label.

before.question: If new Lesson() becomes new Item(), what happens?
choices: An Error rejects instantiation of the abstract class.
It silently creates a Lesson instead.
before.explanation: Item still contains a required abstract operation and cannot be constructed as a concrete object.

after.question: Can the program create an Item directly?
choices: Yes. It has a describe method.
Yes. The label becomes an empty word.
after.explanation: An abstract class cannot be used to make an object directly.
